text.p: - Presidential aide Dmitry Ryurikov described a publication in a Ukrainian newspaper about a Russia's foreign ministry plot to oust Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma as a "dirty, stupid and unprofessional falsification".
The lower house of parliament is to debate a special development budget to determine major investments in 1997.
- Most Russian banks have been in formal violation of the new criminal code since the start of 1997 because they carry out unlicenced activity on the stock market.
- Ukraine is reinforcing a new language policy which will curb the use of Russian.
- The recent publication in a Ukrainian newspaper has aggravated tension between Russia and Ukraine.
- Russia has failed to be a pivot of the Commonwealth of Independent States, said Kazakh president Nursultan Nazarbayev in an interview with the paper.
- The publication in a Ukrainian paper was aimed at discrediting not only the Ukrainian but also the Russian president.
